svg.title: OCP KubeVirt platform: build status
svg.desc: 14 done, 14 partial, 7 not started, of 35 components, as of 2026-11-26.
svg.text: Arrows show who drives whom. A pulsing marker is work in progress.

g.title: Tenant / SRE · External Tenants request clusters and changes; SREs operate the platform.
Wingman portal · In progress Live on the sandbox. Workflow-backed create, upgrades and add-servers are behind flags, off by default. No tenant role yet.
Temporal orchestrator · Done The brain, the per-domain workers and the trigger API.

add-server-to-mce · In progress Bare metal done; the draw comes from the InfraEnv's agentLabels. Not yet: the create-vm child for VM pools (AD29), the zone in the draw, and the installed-by and VM labels on its objects (AD37).

remove-server-from-mce · In progress BareMetalHost and NMStateConfig deleted, metal3 powering the host off; Agent; PXE entries. Not yet: deleting a VM server's VM right after its host is released (AD36).
uninstall-server-from-hc · Done Takes a node out of its hosted cluster, then removes the server from the MCE through its remove-server-from-mce child.
publish-infraenv-to-pxe · Done publish-infraenv-to-pxe-server: republishes an InfraEnv's boot entry.
provision-dell-server · In progress Built; its worker is not deployed.
segment workflows · Done initialize-segment, allocate-segment, release-segment.
provision-cluster · In progress On main; its worker chart is not yet deployed, and Wingman's switch to it is off by default.

update-nodepool · In progress Merged to main: sets a NodePool's replicas; a scale-down marks the Machines that leave, by name or by policy. Not yet: creating a missing NodePool, for the KV Capacity Controller's standby.

create-vm · In progress On main, its deployment still to be confirmed: the zone lock, the oldest KV cluster that fits, a worker in each KV cluster, serial names, KubeMacPool's MAC, a failed create moving on. Not yet: started as add-server-to-mce's child (AD29), and the kv-cluster label.
KV zone lock · In progress On main: one create-vm run at a time chooses a KV cluster in a zone (AD32). Its deployment is still to be confirmed.
delete-stray-vm · In progress On main: removes a VM that a create-vm run left on a cluster it moved on from, by its run-id label. Its deployment is still to be confirmed.
upgrade-cluster · In progress Sandbox only, not production.
deprovision-cluster · Not started Planned. Today an ArgoCD PostDelete hook releases the segment.
day1 repo · Done One file per hosted cluster: NodePools, versions, network.
day2 sig repos · Done Per-team add-ons on every cluster kind.
hostedclusters-setup · In progress Not yet rendered: the redbull.io/claimed exclusion, InfraEnv agentLabels, zone nodeLabels. NodePool annotations: PR #4 open.
ArgoCD · Done The only applicator of desired state.

Capacity policy file · Not started AD31: the ConfigMap capacity-policy, with maxNodes, freeCpuPercent, growAtCpuPercent, standbyWorkers and standbyClusters, read by placement and the KV Capacity Controller.
Customer MCE hubs · Done Tenant hubs running HyperShift and the Agent installer.
Tenant hosted clusters · Done Hosted control planes on the MCE; workers from InfraEnv pools.
Seed clusters · Not started At least one bare-metal seed per zone (AD17). Its day1 folders do not exist yet.
KV clusters · In progress Proven in the lab only.

vm-lifecycle-worker · In progress On main: a worker inside each KV cluster, on that cluster's own queue, reads its figures and creates and deletes VMs. KubeMacPool assigns MACs, so its chart is the same on every KV cluster. Its deployment is still to be confirmed.
kubevirt-redfish · Done Exposes each VM as a Redfish system, so it installs like bare metal.
Node bin-packing · Not started AD30: HighNodeUtilization and CompactAndScale. Not confirmed on any KV cluster.
server-scan · Done Inventory of record, install lock, zone from the ACI leaf.
segments-manager · Done Per-site VLAN segments and who holds them.
DHCP scope manager · Done DHCP scopes, created by Crossplane from day1.
PXE map API · Done Boot entries for servers without virtual media.
Cisco ACI · External The physical leaf a server is cabled to gives its zone.
Inventory Controller · In progress herzi: built, in dry run on every pool, never run against a real hub.
Used-Agent collector · Not started AD34: collects claimed, unbound Agents through remove-server-from-mce. Proposed in herzi#1.
Claimed-Agent tagging · Not started AD34: herzi labels every bound Agent redbull.io/claimed.
KV Capacity Controller · Not started AD27, AD28, AD35: grows each KV NodePool from 70% requested CPU, up to 40 nodes a cluster, and keeps an empty standby. Specification only.
